safetyAndBehavior.questionFormat: Fixed general policy plus exactly one serialized userQuestion field preserving ExactText; literal @ and command-like newlines are JSON data.
safetyAndBehavior.controlledRoleSelection: The CLI --agent flag alone did not select the role in ACP 1.0.92. The provider explicitly selects and verifies it using supported session/set_config_option before any question.
safetyAndBehavior.clarificationBehavior: One prompt per fresh session; fixed general policy requires standalone assumptions, no ask-user tool or follow-up prompt. Bounded full-answer prose checking rejects known input requests, including footers after code blocks; code-literal prompt strings are not treated as invitations.
safetyAndBehavior.stdin: ACP stdin remains open as a machine protocol transport. It is not waiting for interactive user input; each question has one prompt, a terminal end_turn, acknowledged close and a 120-second bounded deadline.
safetyAndBehavior.profile: Owned isolated HOME/USERPROFILE/COPILOT_HOME/work, no ambient MCPs/plugins/custom instructions; only the app-owned validated constant system agent is allowed.
safetyAndBehavior.retention: Agency/Copilot may retain session artifacts inside the owned engine directory until stop/dispose/error/cancellation/rotation. Sessions close and never receive another question. Engine lifetime is bounded to 32 sessions; owned files are removed on teardown.
safetyAndBehavior.authLimit: Authentication notices stop the owned process. This does not guarantee that an external wrapper can never display an expired-auth surface.

parentIntegration: Retain one AgencyCliAnswerProvider for the selected AnswerSettings; do not recreate it per Ask.

Per the corrected startup requirement, await WarmUpAsync(CancellationToken) on startup/reveal/reload before showing Ready. It prepares exactly one empty fresh controlled-role session without submitting a user question or model inference. Repeated calls reuse/join existing preparation.
WarmUpTransportAsync(CancellationToken) remains optional for transport-only diagnostics. It is not the recommended startup API for the measured fast-answer path.
After success the provider prepares the next empty fresh session internally. Asking while preparation is in progress waits on the same bounded gate.
Keep AnswerRequest(RequestId, ExactText) unchanged; do not attach SourceRefs, notes, transcripts, prior questions or instructions derived from them.
Call StopAsync after cancelling on Hide, Clear or protection failure; await cleanup before resuming. DisposeAsync on replacement/reload/application shutdown.

EffectiveModel is a public read-only instance property equal to settings.Model ?? DefaultModel. DefaultModel and ReasoningEffort are public static getters. Final default is gpt-5.6-sol-fast/low; explicit configured overrides remain explicit and never silently fall back.
Provider stage codes include acp_prompt_submitted, provider_delta, acp_end_turn_closed, empty_session_ready and fixed model metadata. Keep UI visibility code ui_visible separate from provider_delta.
ModelStarted marks prompt transport submission, not an unavailable server-internal model start. The provider never logs payload text or flushes the global diagnostics sink.
